item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Mixed, leaning negative. In 2024 there is some evidence that formal probes and court processes were allowed to proceed, but the stronger pattern is that Jokowi tolerated a political environment that discouraged independent scrutiny, especially around election interference, press criticism, and accountability for abuses.

**Evidence**
- `Indonesia's anti-graft body plans to query president's son about private jet trip` | Reuters | 2024-08-28 | [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/indonesias-antigraft-body-plans-to-query-presidents-son-about-private-jet-trip-3590725) | Claim: Indonesia’s anti-graft agency said it would ask Kaesang Pangarep to explain private-jet use and who paid for it, showing that scrutiny of a very close family associate could proceed publicly. | IDs: `7B.6`
- `Indonesian president's son visits anti-graft body over private jet use` | Reuters | 2024-09-17 | [URL](https://www.yahoo.com/news/indonesian-presidents-son-visits-anti-111801430.html) | Claim: Kaesang voluntarily appeared before the anti-graft body and denied misconduct, which is a small positive sign that investigation of an insider was not blocked outright. | IDs: `7B.6`
- `Indonesia court rejects election disputes upholding president-elect Prabowo's win` | Reuters | 2024-04-22 | [URL](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-disputes-upholding-president-elect-prabowos-win/2051390/) | Claim: The court said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling, so the formal challenge process stood and did not get openly crushed. | IDs: `7B.6`
- `Jokowi orders audit of Indonesia's data centres after cyberattack` | Reuters | 2024-06-28 | [URL](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3268495/jokowi-orders-audit-indonesias-data-centres-after-cyberattack) | Claim: After a major cyber failure, Jokowi ordered an audit rather than burying the incident, which is limited evidence of tolerating inquiry into state failure. | IDs: `7B.6`
- `Indonesia leader accused of bias, interference in presidential election` | Reuters | 2024-02-01 | [URL](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-leader-accused-of-bias-interference-in-presidential-election/1948656/) | Claim: Reuters reported criticism that Jokowi was publicly aligning with Prabowo while his son was on the ticket, which undercuts the idea that he welcomed independent scrutiny of his own conduct. | IDs: `7B.6`
- `Indonesia: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report` | Freedom House | 2024 | [URL](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024) | Claim: Freedom House says critics, journalists, and internet users faced harassment and prosecutions; Kominfo could restrict content without appeals; and self-censorship was common. That is strong evidence against broad tolerance of independent investigation and criticism. | IDs: `7B.6`
- `Analysis-A decade of Jokowi: Indonesia's democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say` | Reuters | 2024-10-14 | [URL](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) | Claim: Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says Jokowi’s supporters used courts, the anti-corruption body, and the attorney general’s office for political gain, and that threats of corruption charges were used to keep opponents in line. This is the strongest negative evidence for tolerating independent investigation. | IDs: `7B.6`

**Search Gap**
I did not find strong 2024 reporting that Jokowi himself was formally subjected to a direct, independent investigation of his personal assets or campaign finance. The closest direct items were probes of his son and broader scrutiny of associates, while the negative evidence came mostly from press freedom, election interference, and weak accountability in Papua rather than from a clean asset-disclosure case.
